rows: You were so busy looking for the big mistake that you missed the little one.
Brawling is loud. I prefer to notice what is happening underneath.
A risk is a small crack in a big wall. Which crack are you leaning on?
Slow is a choice, and I can see you making it. That is interesting.
The people see the big moments. I notice the small ones. Let me show you one.
Short version: I notice things, and I am going to point one out.
Some people call me cold. I call it paying attention.
Look at my stance. It is still, and that is deliberate.
You say technique. Show me the small detail you rely on. The rest is noise.
Strikes make the sound. The mistake is in the timing before them.
A risk is fine when you have checked the little things. Have you?
A stall gives away its own mistake. You are doing it now.
The people deserve the detail, not the spectacle. Give them the detail.
You think you are among the best. The small mistakes say otherwise.
You are proud of your {strength}. It is a good strength, and it has one small crack in it.
I have looked closely at your {strength}, and there is one thing you keep missing.
You kept calm. Good, but calm does not hide the detail. I can still see it.
Fair. You have noticed the same small thing I have.
I could say something sharp. I would rather point at the small mistake instead.
One fall. Keep me down, and the small mistake will be the reason.
On the mat, the small things matter most. Watch your hips.
Grounded or standing, the small detail decides it.
Stay in front of me. Let me show you what you are missing.
Good answer. The detail is right, which is rarer than you think.
You have not answered. The silence tells me more than the words would.
Fair. I did not expect you to see that.
I accept that. The little mistakes will tell us the rest at the bell.
I will watch every small thing in this match, and I will use what I see.
My approach is quiet. You will see it when the details start to matter.
Whatever happens, the small things will be the story.
It is not finished. The small mistake is still there.
I have one more detail to point out, and you will see it when the bell rings.
